senses.gloss: (v. preced. wds.) to embrace (in a fight), to wrestle.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevuot 6:2">Tosef. Shebu. VI, 2</cite> <he>כל זמן שהיו חוֹבְבִין זה את זה</he> (Var. <he>חוֹכְכִין</he>) as long as they were fighting each other, i.e. if the case comes up immediately after the fight took place; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevuot 6:2">ib.</cite>

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:28">B. Kam. IX, 28</cite> <he>חוככין</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 7:3:2">Y. Shebu. VII, 37ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חוככין</he>.—V. <cite ref="H00054"><he>חֲבִיבָאֵי</he></cite>.
